_about: Rules for tools/spec_index.py and tools/spec_rules_view.py (docs/plan_model_ergonomics.md, Parts B and C). Editorial content, so it lives here and not in the tools (global rule 9). Each list says which tool reads it.

source_id_patterns._read_by: tools/spec_index.py: the citation forms of the six corpus sources and the cross-source resolutions, from docs/model_explainer.md's 'Reading the citations' table, plus the ledger's consolidated entries and the design-lessons notes. A requirement's `sources` field holds every match in its block, in order of first appearance.

history_phrases._read_by: tools/spec_rules_view.py (C4): a sentence in a requirement body that matches one of these is an inline revision narrative, listed in docs/spec_rules/history_in_body.md for the owner's decision (Part E). Matched as written, case-sensitively; the tool strips nothing.
